verdict.rationale: The official clickhousectl CLI covers creating databases (launching local servers and creating ClickHouse Cloud clusters), managing Cloud resources, and connecting to servers to execute queries, all without the dashboard. However, an interactive shell and dedicated inspect/describe commands are not explicitly documented, so coverage of the full daily loop is incomplete. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented interactive shell/REPL into a database, dedicated inspect/describe/status commands for databases, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI's daily-loop use.

support.subject: As a developer, the official CLI covers my daily loop — create, connect, shell into, and inspect databases — without opening the dashboard

citations.quote: With clickhousectl you can: * Install and manage local ClickHouse versions * Launch and manage local ClickHouse servers
Execute queries against ClickHouse servers * Set up ClickHouse Cloud and create cloud-managed ClickHouse clusters
